title: Payslips
editHint: To change a payslip, delete it and record it again.

error.title: Payslips did not load
error.body: Check your connection and try again.

empty.title: No payslips yet
empty.body: Record each payout as its gross, the tax withheld and the service fee, linked to the transfer to your bank.

delete.title: Delete this payslip?
delete.body: Its gross and deductions leave your ledger. The transfer to your bank stays, ready to link again.

form.payoutHint: The movement that took the net out of this account.
form.noCandidates: No transfer out of this account is waiting for a payslip.
form.laterHint: A transfer of the net to the account you choose is recorded too.
form.feeHint: The rest: gross minus tax minus net.

problems.transferId: Choose the transfer, or No transfer yet
problems.deductions: The deductions are more than the gross minus the net
problems.taxCategory: Choose a category for the tax
problems.feeCategory: Choose a category for the fee
problems.extra: Enter an amount and a category, or remove the line
